title: Right cones take monomorphisms to right anodyne maps
statement: Use simplicial sets, standard simplices and horns as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For simplicial sets $X,Y$, define their join by $(X\star Y)_r=X_r\amalg Y_r\amalg\coprod_{u+v+1=r}X_u\times Y_v$, with simplicial operators induced by restricting the ordered concatenation of the $X$-vertices followed by the $Y$-vertices. Write $X^{\triangleright}=X\star\Delta^0$, with $X$ as its base and the additional vertex as its cone point. Call a simplicial map right anodyne if it belongs to the smallest class containing all isomorphisms and all horn inclusions $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0<i\leq n$, and closed under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts. For every simplicial map $u:A\to B$ that is injective in every simplicial degree, the induced map $u^{\triangleright}=u\star\operatorname{id}_{\Delta^0}:A^{\triangleright}\to B^{\triangleright}$ is right anodyne.

source.place: Kerodon Lemma 4.3.7.8 (0196), first assertion. The convention for right anodyne is Variant 4.2.4.2. This is a Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag. Online text read; archival copy WANTED in report.md.
